name: Juusha-chan to Yaya Zannen na Yuusha no Hanashi
original_name: 従者ちゃんとやや残念な勇者の話
source:
An indentured elf is in increasingly difficult situations in the service of her hero master.

The hero is hapless so she tries to encourage him, which leads to many sexual situations.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083945.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一名契约精灵在为她的英雄主人服务的过程中陷入了越来越困难的境地。

主人公很不幸，所以她试图鼓励他，这导致了许多性行为的发生。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083945.html]DLsite English[/url]]
